llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must compose `Gesture.LongPress()` and `Gesture.Pan()` with RNGH composition APIs (for example `Gesture.Simultaneous(...)`) so drag is gated by long-press activation.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Gesture.LongPress() and Gesture.Pan() are composed with Gesture.Simultaneous(longPress, pan), gating drag via manualActivation and isDragEnabled shared value set in longPress.onStart.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement gating in pan callbacks by checking long-press activation state before applying translation updates, and MUST NOT use legacy `useAnimatedGestureHandler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Pan's onTouchesMove checks isDragEnabled.value (set by longPress.onStart) before calling stateManager.activate(); useAnimatedGestureHandler is not used anywhere.
evidence: No import or usage of useAnimatedGestureHandler found

llmJudgeRequirements.description: `Gesture.Pan().onUpdate(...)` must clamp horizontal translation using the existing `DRAG_LIMIT` constant (bounded to `-DRAG_LIMIT` and `DRAG_LIMIT`) before assigning `translateX`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: onUpdate clamps with Math.max(-DRAG_LIMIT, Math.min(DRAG_LIMIT, raw)) and assigns the result to translateX.value, using the DRAG_LIMIT constant defined at the top of the file.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must drive card style from a Reanimated shared value using `useAnimatedStyle`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: animatedCardStyle is produced by useAnimatedStyle reading the activated shared value via interpolateColor and is applied to the Animated.View card.
evidence: const animatedCardStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => { const borderColor = interpolateColor(activated.value, ...) ... })
